skills.name: Scan orchestration
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define the scan plan: order, dependencies, limits (file.write).
2. Run stages with process.exec/python.run_file.
3. Persist intermediate outputs per stage.
4. Aggregate at the end (python.run_file).
5. Report with stats.

skills.name: Tool output normalization
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect sample outputs from each tool (http.history/files).
2. Write per-tool parsers (python.run_file).
3. Emit one JSON schema.
4. Round-trip test parsers.
5. Save the normalizer.

skills.name: Finding deduplication
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Key findings by (host,path,param,type) (python.run_file).
2. Merge evidence, keep highest severity.
3. Track sources per finding.
4. Report unique set.
5. Archive raws.

skills.name: Severity calibration
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define your matrix (file.write): impact x exploitability.
2. Map findings to cells.
3. Review outliers manually.
4. Keep the matrix versioned.
5. Use everywhere.

skills.name: Markdown report builder
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read findings JSON (file.read).
2. Render per-finding sections via python.run_file.
3. Embed evidence links.
4. Redact secrets automatically.
5. Output the md file.

skills.name: Evidence artifact store
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Create per-finding folders (file.write).
2. Move evidence in with process.exec mv.
3. Write an index.json (python.run_file).
4. Hash files for integrity.
5. Reference in reports.

skills.name: Target state tracker
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Maintain state.json per target (python.run_file).
2. Record tested endpoints and results.
3. Resume incomplete scans.
4. Summarize coverage %.
5. Report gaps.

skills.name: Tool health checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. runtime.info for runtimes.
2. Probe key tools with harmless runs (process.exec/python.run_file).
3. Record versions.
4. Flag missing pieces.
5. Proceed only when green.

skills.name: Credential handling notes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Load secrets from env/files at runtime (python.run_file).
2. Never hard-code; scan with python.run_file patterns.
3. Rotate after engagements.
4. Document the pattern.
5. Enforce in review.

skills.name: Workspace layout standard
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Standard folders: recon, evidence, reports, notes (file.write).
2. Name by date + target.
3. Clean tmp weekly.
4. Index with a manifest.
5. Summarize layout.

skills.name: Recon pipeline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Stage 1 passive (web.search).
2. Stage 2 active within scope (net.portscan, web.crawl).
3. Normalize outputs (python.run_file).
4. Update the attack surface map.
5. Report deltas.

skills.name: Finding diff engine
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Load previous findings (file.read).
2. Diff with new set (python.run_file).
3. Classify: new, fixed, persistent.
4. Alert on regressions.
5. Save the diff.

skills.name: Digest notifications
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compose short digests after runs (python.run_file).
2. Top findings + stats only.
3. Send via chat summary.
4. Archive digests.
5. Review cadence weekly.

skills.name: Simple charts for reports
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Generate PNG charts via python.run_file (matplotlib if present).
2. Severity counts, trend lines.
3. Embed paths in reports.
4. Keep charts readable.
5. Save under evidence.

skills.name: Local scheduler notes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Document jobs and intervals (file.write).
2. Use device alarms via app features (user setup).
3. Log runs to files.
4. Review outputs weekly.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: CLI tool wrappers
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write wrapper scripts with sane defaults (file.write).
2. Validate inputs; refuse unscoped targets.
3. Log invocations.
4. Version the wrappers.
5. Test each once.

skills.name: Engagement config templates
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Template configs for target/scope/limits (file.write).
2. Copy per engagement.
3. Fill and review.
4. Track changes in git.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Review checklists
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Maintain per-type checklists (file.write): web, api, mobile.
2. Run through them during work.
3. Record checked items with dates.
4. Feed gaps into backlog.
5. Summarize compliance.

skills.name: Team knowledge base
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. One note per lesson (file.write).
2. Tag by technology.
3. Link evidence.
4. Review monthly.
5. Prune stale.

skills.name: Playbook versioning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Version playbooks in files (file.write).
2. Changelog each update.
3. Deprecate old versions explicitly.
4. Link from runbooks.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Repro documentation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Step-by-step text with exact inputs (file.write).
2. Attach screenshots (web.browser capture).
3. Note environment specifics.
4. Verify from clean state.
5. Attach to findings.

skills.name: Scan scheduling policy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Policy file: windows, blackout times (file.write).
2. Honor production change freezes.
3. Log deviations.
4. Review quarterly.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Quota tracking
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Log usage per run (python.run_file).
2. Compare against quotas (web.search provider docs).
3. Alert at 80%.
4. Adjust plans.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Finding triage queue
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Queue file with status fields (file.write).
2. Triage daily: valid/dup/wontfix.
3. Assign owners.
4. Track SLA.
5. Summarize queue.

skills.name: Engagement retrospectives
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect what worked/pain points (file.write).
2. Actions with owners.
3. Feed into playbooks.
4. Archive after review.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Tool integration matrix
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map outputs-to-inputs between tools (file.write).
2. Test each integration once.
3. Document failures.
4. Plan replacements.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Engagement data backup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Archive workspace to shared storage (process.exec cp).
2. Encrypt sensitive archives.
3. Verify restore of one archive.
4. Rotate old archives.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Legal hold awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify hold scope with the owner.
2. Freeze deletion for in-scope files (documented list).
3. Log access.
4. Release only in writing.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: SLA tracking
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compute ages from finding dates (python.run_file).
2. Compare to policy SLAs.
3. Escalate breaches.
4. Report weekly.
5. Archive.

skills.name: Metrics dashboard (files)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Maintain metrics.json (python.run_file).
2. Render a summary table (python.run_file).
3. Review trends monthly.
4. Feed planning.
5. Summarize.
